questions.prompt: Who are the changes meant to help?
options: New carers and people already providing foster care.
Children preparing to study at boarding school.
Adults starting work in residential care homes.
Families planning to spend a weekend on holiday.
questions.explanationZh: 招募活动寻找新人，后文又说明变化也支持已有照护者；不是寄宿学校或旅游项目。

questions.prompt: What will some new programmes test?
options: Care arranged only during the school holidays.
Care offered only by people over forty.
Care provided only in residential centres.
questions.explanationZh: 第8句明确举出周末照护，是拟试验的灵活形式。

Existing carers who receive weekend support.
New foster places the government wants to create.
Children who have already moved into foster families.
